# HexPiece 2.8.3

- **New 3D effects on every fighting style's blows:** each kick and punch leaves a smear along the limb's real path, straight
  blows throw rings of shocked air, and a landed blow bursts into an anime impact star.
  - **Black Leg:** hot orange-white kick smears. The Flame Leg's spin leaves a ring of fire.
  - **Fishman Karate:** water winds round your arm into the blow, bursts out of the palm, and where it lands a crown of water opens
    with ripples racing out and drops flung off.
  - **Iron Fist:** shock rings and speed lines off every punch. Gatling Jabs becomes a barrage of them.
  - **Six Powers:** smears on its kicks, on top of its own air effects.
- **Haki on or off:** with Armament (or Ryou) on, the same blows turn black with red edges and crackle with black-and-red bolts. Fishman
  Karate's water turns dark.
- In first person your own blows' effects fade near the camera and are smaller, so the target stays in sight.
- Nothing here has been tested in game yet. The build's checks pass, and every effect was rendered and checked off-game.
